description: Seven selected giant statues rendered with text-generated Cloudflare FLUX.2 Klein 4B images at fixed 4 steps. All images are AI illustrations; recognizable details and proportions may differ from actual monuments. Shared linear height scale, approximate sourced figure heights, no narration or soundtrack. Sculptural head ornaments and held objects are included; separate architectural pedestals and lotus thrones are excluded. Spring Temple Buddha uses the operator-reported 108 m figure-only height. This is an experimental curated selection, not an exhaustive tallest-statue ranking. The planned Statue of Unity image could not be completed because Cloudflare exhausted its daily free allowance. #Statues #SizeComparison #Shorts
